747100101.text: Hehe... Well-behaved little fish swimming to and fro in spacious, carefully arranged tanks...

747100102.text: It really is a beautiful sight.

747100103.text: That's why our aquarium's so popular!

747100104.text: If only they were this well-behaved in open waters... then people could dive down and immerse themselves more deeply in the beauty of the natural world.

747100105.text: Anyway, thanks to your help, I've got to the bottom of why these fish were so agitated...

747100106.text: Over the years, there have been plenty of shipwrecks, and even some absolute scoundrels illegally dumping waste in the sea...

747100107.text: A huge amount of man-made junk has sunk to the seabed, piling up and destroying natural habitats. It's this that's caused the fish to become increasingly aggressive...

747100108.text: Apparently, a group of divers has already accepted a commission to clean up the junk.

747100109.text: But it looks like I'll have to give them a polite kick up the backside and ask them to pick up the pace...

747100112.text: Yes. In the meantime, let's continue our work by bringing in as many aggressive little fish as possible to help them relax and recuperate.

747100113.text: Isolating the patients from their harmful environment is an important step on the road to recovery.

747100114.text: Got it! Just leave it to us! We'll keep our eyes peeled for new patients.
